subject: Identity controls & SOC 2 deliverables — requested evidence and bridge period
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestviewhealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@crestviewhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + specific identity controls evidence request

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To complete our security review for Crestview’s procurement committee, we need the following so we can close the security questionnaire and finish a brief SIG assessment:

- SOC 2 Type II report (covering 2026 audit period) + any bridge letter if the report does not cover Jan 1–Dec 31 2026.
- A slice of authentication logs for the audit period (we'd prefer Nov–Dec 2026) showing timestamp, user_id (hashed ok), event_type (login/sso/mfa_challenge), result (success/fail), and IP (city-level OK).
- Evidence that MFA is enforced for interactive console/API access: policy doc and a short extract showing device enrollment timestamps (redacted usernames ok).
- Most recent privileged access review (sample of records) and confirmation whether contractors are included in that review.

Can you confirm what you can share, any redaction rules, and an estimated delivery date? Also let me know if a short non-disclosure addendum or file transfer method (SFTP / secure Drive link) is required.

We are aiming to complete procurement by March 5.

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Senior Information Security Manager
Crestview Health

--
Attachments: none
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestviewhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@crestviewhealth.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + specific identity controls evidence request

Emily —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything requested with standard redaction for PII. High level responses and next steps below; Marcus (security) and Naomi (Customer Ops) are on-copy to coordinate artifacts and delivery.

What we can provide now:
- Attached: Redwood SOC 2 Type II report for the 2026 audit period (redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf). If you need an explicit bridge letter that extends coverage to Jan 1–Dec 31 2026, we can produce a short attestation from our auditor; please confirm that’s required.
- Log slice: we can provide a gzipped CSV with the fields you listed (user_id hashed, event_type, result, timestamp, city-level IP). We will redact full IPs and user identifiers per our policy; we can include a mapping key under a separate NDA if needed.
- MFA evidence: we will include our MFA enforcement policy and an extract of enrollment timestamps. Our MFA requirement is enforced for all console and API sessions via SSO + device bindings; we can include device_enrollment_ts for sample accounts.
- Access review: we can include the last privileged access review export and confirm whether contractors were in scope (they are included in the identity inventory and marked as contractor in the access review metadata).

Proposed delivery timeline:
- Preliminary artifacts (SOC 2 PDF + policy docs + auth_log_schema.md) — by Feb 22 EOD PST.
- Redacted auth log slice and access review samples — by Feb 26.

Transfer method: secure Drive link is fine; if you require SFTP or an NDA addendum we can do DocuSign.

Let me know if you need the bridge letter; we will route to our auditor if you do.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0112

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestviewhealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@crestviewhealth.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + specific identity controls evidence request

Emily / team —

Quick technical clarifications from Engineering (copying the items we'll prepare):

1) Auth log fields available: timestamp (UTC), event_type (login, sso_redirect, mfa_challenge, token_issue), result (success/fail), user_id (SHA256 hashed), client_ip (city-level), user_agent, session_id (rotating). We will remove any raw IPs beyond city-level and will not include raw user email addresses in the CSV.

2) MFA evidence: we can produce an extract with device_enrollment_ts, method (TOTP / WebAuthn), and last_challenge_result for each sample user. Note — we will not export secret material.

3) Access reviews: exports include account_id (hashed), role, reviewer_id (hashed), review_outcome, review_period_start/end. Contractors are tagged via a contractor boolean column.

4) Redaction & sample size: we will provide a two-week slice for Nov 15–Dec 15 2026 (this is lighter than full Nov–Dec but preserves a representative sample). If you need full Nov–Dec we can do it but will require additional processing time (add 3 business days).

I'll attach a short schema doc (auth_log_schema.md) and will prepare the CSV: auth_logs_202611-202612.csv.gz (redacted). Naomi — can you confirm delivery timing for the CSV and access review export?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

--
Attachment: auth_log_schema.md (text, 4KB)
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestviewhealth.com>

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@crestviewhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + specific identity controls evidence request

Thanks — this looks good. A few quick asks before we finalize: 

- Please provide the bridge letter attesting coverage for Jan 1–Dec 31 2026; our procurement team requires it for financial sign-off.
- For the auth log slice, Nov 15–Dec 15 2026 is acceptable if you prefer the smaller window. Please indicate if CSV will be gzip-compressed and whether it will include a header row.
- Can you add an attestation line confirming retention policy (we need confirmation that auth logs are retained at least 12 months) and whether MFA secret rotations occur on a quarterly cadence for service accounts?
- Confirm that the privileged access review export includes contractor accounts (from your note it sounds like yes).

If you can deliver the bridge letter + SOC2 PDF + policy docs + auth_log_schema.md by Feb 22 and the redacted CSV + access review export by Feb 26 we will be able to keep our procurement timeline. If DocuSign is needed for bridge letter signature, send the envelope link.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Emily
